_note: Seed parameters for the standardized TELx pools. Amounts are whole tokens (100000 eUSD, not 100000000000); the scripts scale by each token's decimals. The two amounts define the pool's opening price as amount1/amount0, so they must be reviewed as a pair. 0 means not yet decided: run() refuses it and planAll() reports it. widthBps is the half-width of the seeded band in basis points, 0 for full range. maxTickDeviation is how far the live tick may sit from the tick the amounts imply before seeding is refused (50 ticks is about 0.5%); slippageBps is how far above the computed mint cost the on-chain maximums are set. Both come from defaults unless a pool overrides them.
